exact_statement: For the distinct-Finset Erdős 786 hypergraph H_N on {2,...,N}, prove tau(H_N)=o(N), and for every epsilon>0 construct by a coherent compatible rule an infinite admissible set whose natural-density limit exists and is greater than 1-epsilon. Compare arithmetic alteration/dependency compression, largest-prime ownership carrying the full cofactor residue, and recursive residue-token potentials with coherent stabilization. An all-parameter decisive theorem or countermechanism against a precisely frozen member of these families may qualify only as a scoped standalone promotion and does not replace either public density-one target.
scope_notes: Variant lock: products are Finset products. After cancelling shore overlap, coefficients lie in {-1,0,1}; no integer repeats on one shore and the repetitions-allowed additive-function variant is excluded.
The finite primary target is tau(H_N)=o(N) for the full bad-support hypergraph on {2,...,N}. This is the finite density-one distinct-factor assertion after deleting the forced element 1.

The infinite target requires, for every epsilon>0, one admissible set with an actual natural-density limit greater than 1-epsilon. Unrelated finite transversals, upper density, logarithmic density, or endpoint density do not suffice.
Read-only audited input F786: w_N(n)=log(N/n)/log N is a fractional cover of exact total (N log N-log(N!))/log N-1=(1+o(1))N/log N.

Read-only audited input IR.1: every moving o(N)-cost lower-power tail on N=2^K contains a support-minimal bad relation; finite nested thresholds and unaltered affordable independent proportional rounding are blocked.
This campaign must retain cofactor residue whenever it peels a prime. The relation 2*3=6 forbids residue-free triangularity.

The three required independent mechanism families are arithmetic alteration/dependency compression, largest-prime ownership with cofactor residue, and recursive residue-token potential with coherent stabilization.
A claimed recursive improvement must exhibit a target-specific potential or amortized load. Merely encoding the original signed relation in a token state is circular.
Public search for an exact solution to Erdos 786 is prohibited. Ordinary background results with exact hypotheses are permitted.

variant_lock.allowed: two finite subsets of distinct positive integers, overlap cancelled
variant_lock.forbidden: multiplicity within a shore or arbitrary integer coefficients
variant_lock.exceptional_elements: 1 is forced out; 0 is incompatible with positive density

exact_subproblems.finite: Construct an integral transversal D_N of all bad supports with |D_N|=o(N).
exact_subproblems.alteration: Compress/resample arithmetic bad events so that the total alteration cost is o(log N) times the promoted fractional mass.
exact_subproblems.ownership: Define a noncircular largest-prime plus cofactor-residue owner with o(log N) aggregate load.
exact_subproblems.recursion: Prove a residue-token potential decreases or amortizes over all depths; for the infinite part also prove compatible stabilization and zero upper density of deletions.
